---
title: "Teaching"
params:
  image_dir: "docs/images"
---


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE)
# Source assets live in docs/images; rendered HTML also lives in docs/.
# Centralize the source directory here, while generating browser-relative URLs.
site_image <- function(filename) {
  source_file <- file.path(params$image_dir, filename)
  if (!file.exists(source_file)) stop("Missing image: ", source_file)
  file.path("images", filename)
}
```
